720p reading preset: full side by side

720p is the reading preset: a separate 1280×720 desktop makes text larger than a fitted Full HD desktop. Changing only the link does not enlarge mirrored text. Half formats send 1280×720 and restore both eyes on the phone, trading detail for fewer pixels. These options use H.264 and need the updated computer components. Native keeps optional HEVC. Stop Throwing before changing this choice.
